lost.title: Lost connection to KumiCraft
lost.body: Trying to reconnect. You can keep working once the connection is back.

noProject.title: No project is open
noProject.body: KumiCraft opens the project in the folder where you started it. This folder has no KumiCraft project yet (.kumicraft/workspace.json).

projectError.title: Cannot open the project
projectError.oldVersion: This project was saved by an older KumiCraft that kept the design in JSON files. That format is no longer read.
projectError.howToFix: KumiCraft never overwrites .kumicraft/workspace.json. Fix or remove the file, then start KumiCraft again.

editor.canvasPending: The Canvas will show your project running here, from its own dev server.
editor.untrustedBody: You must trust the project to start the dev server.
editor.needsInstallBody: Run the install command to finish setting up the project before starting the dev server.
editor.cannotCloseLastFrame: At least one frame must stay open
editor.bridgeSilent: The page Bridge has not connected after 10 seconds. The page may be failing or missing the Bridge plugin.
editor.toggleLeft: Show or hide the left panel ({{shortcut}}: both panels)
editor.toggleRight: Show or hide the right panel ({{shortcut}}: both panels)
editor.layersHint: The structure of the page shows here once the Canvas runs your project.
editor.selectHint: Select an element on the Canvas to edit its Tailwind classes here.
editor.restricted: Restricted mode: nothing of this project runs

narrow.title: The Studio needs a screen at least 1024 px wide
narrow.body: Open it on a computer or widen the browser window. Your source code is not affected.

editor.pageParamHint: Replace :params with values, then press Enter

history.errorFileChanged: File {{file}} was modified externally, cannot undo this step

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Changes at once, without reloading. Remembered for every project on this computer.
settings.editorHelp: "Open in editor" jumps to the file and line of the selected element in this editor.
settings.packageManagerHelp: Installs the dependencies of a project KumiCraft creates. An existing project keeps its own.
settings.agentPreferredHelp: Auto chooses the ready assistant. You can also pick a fixed one.
settings.loginSessions: Several sign-in sessions on the Canvas
settings.loginSessionsHelp: Shows a "Sign-in" picker on the Canvas toolbar. Each session keeps its own sign-in, for apps where you need two roles at once (for example customer and farmer). Off: the Canvas uses one sign-in.

trust.bar: This project is not trusted: its dev server, dependency installs and AI agents do not run. You can still look around.
trust.title: Do you trust this project?
trust.intro: Running a project runs its own code: the Vite configuration, its plugins and its dependencies. Trust only projects you know.
trust.restricted: Until you trust it, KumiCraft does not start its dev server, install its dependencies or run an AI agent on it.
trust.backends: Linked backends (the AI agent reads a read-only copy)
trust.backendOutside: Outside the folder that holds the project, check carefully

project.notProject: This folder has files but is not a Vite + React project. Pick an empty folder to create a project, or a folder with a Vite + React project to open it.
project.styleNotEditable: Visual styling: not supported for this system yet, use AI to change styling
project.styleUnsupportedInspector: Visual styling is not supported for {{system}} yet. Select an element and ask AI in the AI tab.

reasons.noVite: Project does not include Vite in dependencies
reasons.noReact: Project does not include React in dependencies
reasons.noTailwind: Project does not include Tailwind CSS
reasons.craUnsupported: Create React App has been deprecated by React (2025). KumiCraft 1.0 supports React + Vite; migrating to Vite is recommended by React.
reasons.nextUnsupported: Next.js is not yet supported in KumiCraft 1.0, planned for 1.1.
reasons.webpackUnsupported: React projects with custom webpack configuration are not yet supported; KumiCraft 1.0 supports React + Vite.

install.title: Install dependencies
install.description: Dependencies need to be installed before the dev server can run.

backends.title: Linked Backends
backends.confirmRemove: Are you sure you want to remove this backend link?

devPort.title: Frontend port in the Canvas
devPort.hint: Empty: KumiCraft reads the project's port (--port in the dev script, vite.config, 5173 by default) so the backend accepts it as with npm run dev. Saving restarts the dev server.
devPort.invalid: The port must be a number from 1024 to 65535, or empty

designDirs.title: Default design directories
designDirs.hint: Default directories for pages, layouts, and components (relative to project root).

inspector.title: Properties
inspector.multiLocked: Cannot edit together: <{{tag}}> at {{loc}} has className defined by an expression
inspector.askAi: Ask AI to change this element

lockReason.classExpression: ClassName is an expression, cannot edit visually
lockReason.outsideSource: Element is outside the source directory
lockReason.tooLarge: File is too large to edit visually

warning.usages: Changes apply to all usages of {{name}} ({{count}} places)
warning.loop: Repeated {{count}} times: edits apply to all instances
warning.missingImport: Missing import for inserted component, please check the file
warning.foreignExpression: The pasted code uses variables from its original file and may need changes
warning.attributesDropped: Attributes other than className were dropped upon unwrap

errors.sourceConflict: Source file was modified externally, reloaded

borders.mixedSides: The sides differ: give them the same value and they merge into all 4 sides
borders.mixedCorners: The corners differ: give them the same value and they merge into all 4 corners

errors.expression: Source contains expressions, cannot edit visually
errors.mixed: Source contains mixed content, cannot edit visually
errors.readonly: File is read-only, cannot edit visually
errors.saveFailed: Failed to save text edit to source

buildError.title: Build error, the canvas shows the last working build

portBusy.message: Port {{port}} of the project is busy (npm run dev may be running), so the Canvas runs on another port and the backend may refuse its requests. Stop the program that holds the port, then restart.

actions.toggleFrameFocus: One frame at a time / side by side

pages.title: Pages
pages.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete page "{{path}}"? This will remove its route, component, and file.
pages.notConvention: The project does not follow the routes.tsx convention. Adding, renaming, and deleting pages are disabled.
pages.name: Page name
pages.fileAuto: Automatic: {{name}} (extension of the pages in the folder)
pages.routerAmbiguous: Multiple router files found. Choose which file to use for adding pages:
pages.routerUnsupported: Router in {{file}} does not support automatic editing ({{reason}}).
pages.routerNone: Project does not have React Router yet.
pages.installRouterStep1: Add "react-router" to package.json and install packages
pages.installRouterStep2: Create src/routes with / pointing to the current root component
pages.installRouterStep3: Update the entry file to render <RouterProvider>
pages.installRouterUndoHint: Undo restores all modified source files (installed packages in node_modules remain).

design.unknownFile: The file of this page is unknown
design.selectInFileForeign: {{name}} lives in {{foreignFile}}, outside the file you are designing. Select an element in {{file}}, or open {{name}} to insert there.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.ignoredWarning: The drafts directory is ignored by .gitignore. Changes will not be committed to Git.
drafts.freeWarning: Freeform drafts use fixed positions; check responsive display on mobile after promoting.
drafts.providerHint: Draft runs outside the app; this component may need a Provider.

components.title: Components
components.empty: This project has no components yet
components.selfInsert: A component cannot be inserted into itself

extract.title: Extract component
extract.name: Component name
extract.invalidPascal: Component name must be PascalCase (e.g. MyComponent).
extract.nameExists: A component with this name already exists.

freeFrame.confirmDisable: Turning off free frame will switch child elements back to normal flow. Continue?
freeFrame.measureTimeout: Failed to measure frame size (2s timeout).
freeFrame.pageWarning: This is a regular page, not a draft. In-place visual editing with free frame may affect responsive layouts. Consider promoting to a draft.

brand.name: Token name
brand.confirmRemove: Token {{name}} is used in {{count}} place(s). Remove it from @theme? (Existing classes will be kept.)
brand.noThemeFile: Project has no Tailwind CSS file
brand.invalidName: Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; must start with a letter (max 40 chars)

files.title: Files
files.invalidName: Invalid name or contains forbidden characters (/ \ : * ? " < > |)
files.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}?
files.deleteFolderRouterPages: Directory contains {{count}} router pages; routes will fail.

sessions.title: Login sessions
sessions.localhostUnsupported: This browser cannot open *.localhost addresses; use Chrome, Edge, or Firefox
sessions.explain: Each session keeps its own sign-in in the Canvas (cookies and local storage). Use one per role, for example Customer and Farmer, and switch without signing in again.
